_comment: Vertical-stack region 3 of 3: the disc of Limbo, the First Circle. Owns the limbo terrain region (disc heightmap + ceiling + rock-collar walls) + the Acheron trench modifier. No static meshes today (no chapel-style architecture yet in Limbo); enemy_spawns will populate with shades in Commit 7. Return-trigger fires when player walks back into the descent corridor mouth (heading north toward Z > -346.85).

terrain_modifiers._comment: Acheron trench. The river that cuts E-W across Limbo per [[project_acheron_river_lore]]. Disc Limbo radius 300m, center Z=-621.15. Trench is a chord at Z=-385 (~32m south of the corridor landing at Z=-353.15) -- the first feature the player encounters walking into Limbo. Trench depth 4m below Limbo floor (-43.13), 12m wide N-S, 340m wide E-W (170m half-extent stays 15m short of disc rim at ±185m). Sharp -X/+X edges (disc rim clips laterally), sloped -Z/+Z banks (5m blend pad = ~38° grade).

triggers._comment: Player walks back into the descent corridor mouth from Limbo, heading north (toward Z=-346 then up the stairs). Mirrors chapel_interior's limbo_descent_enter trigger.

_enemy_spawns_note: Shade encounter layout per [[project_acheron_river_lore]] + the canonical Limbo doctrine. All shades sit SOUTH of the Acheron trench (Z < -385) -- they're the human-gone-mad inhabitants who were on the far shore BEFORE the throughput stopped. The near-shore side will eventually carry the soul 'larvae' piling on the riverbank waiting for the absent ferry (separate system, TBD). Each light cluster from registerLimboLights gets a pair of shades flanking the light, both facing north (yaw=0 = -Z, the direction the player crosses Acheron from) -- they read as the dying-inhabitants' guards watching the river approach. 16 shades total across 8 light clusters. All Y=-43.13 (Limbo floor); tickEnemyLocomotion snaps to ground each frame.

Cluster 1 (limbo_campfire_a): 4m east flank, watching the same approach.

Cluster 4 (limbo_fungus_b at 120,-650): far east of the lit field, west flank of bowl.
Cluster 5 (limbo_brazier_a at 80,-740): bright warm brazier, west flank.
Cluster 6 (limbo_brazier_b at 0,-780): brightest light in Limbo (intensity 1.0, radius 16). Central pair, west flank.
Cluster 6 (limbo_brazier_b): east flank of the central brazier.
Cluster 7 (limbo_campfire_c at -130,-820): deep south-west, west flank.
Cluster 8 (limbo_fungus_c at 30,-870): southernmost cluster, ~250m south of Acheron. West flank.
Cluster 8 (limbo_fungus_c): east flank, deepest into Limbo. Reward encounter for full exploration.
